message:
Let me create the PoC file and test it with the harness.

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct
parser_flags = 0x80000
renderer_flags = 0
data = b'    codeblock\n> [!note]\n> foo\n'
poc = struct.pack('<II', parser_flags, renderer_flags) + data
with open('/workspace/poc1.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print('PoC written:', len(poc), 'bytes')
" && bash build.sh 'cp /workspace/poc1.bin /tmp/poc1.bin && /tmp/harness /tmp/poc1.bin 2>&1 | head -50'</parameter>
